name: opinions-converging
description: delete converging={} in opinions temporary_opinion blocks

name: relation-flags
description: re-encode scripted_relations flags bitsets to 1.20's 1-byte width

name: title-names
description: move inline title name/adj/pre/article into title_name_data

name: game-rule-blanks
description: delete empty "" entries from game_rules settings lists

name: empty-keys
description: delete map entries with an empty key (=-5000.1.1)

name: dead-liege-cycles
description: drop the recorded liege of dead characters whose liege chain loops

name: unrun-war-coordinators
description: drop AI war coordinators that were never run (no stance, supply limit 0) and their war plans

name: impassable-provinces
description: clear old holdings, soldier pools and sieges from provinces the target map makes impassable; move units off

name: dead-titles-report
description: report titles the game no longer defines (no edit)

name: empty-modifiers
description: delete modifiers with an empty name (modifier="", "" in modifiers lists, type="")

name: religion-transplant
description: replace religion with a 1.20 reference's religion/faiths/rites/organizations, ids translated

name: custom-faith
description: carry the save's own custom faiths (e.g. Way of Scarcity) as a faith or a rite

name: faith-to-rite
since: 1.20.0 (characters and counties point at a rite)
description: replace faith=<old id> with rite=<new id>; remap faith/religion variables

name: faithless-rite
description: give characters without a faith their house head's rite (fallbacks reported)

name: dead-titles
since: 1.13 to 1.20 (titles the map rework removed or moved)
description: rename the save's dead and moved titles to their 1.20 successors where the mapping is clean; remove the rest (split, wasteland, dropped), reported

name: new-titles
description: plan the titles and provinces the save does not have, from a 1.20 reference save

name: people
since: 1.13 to 1.20 (the new regions' rulers, courts and families)
description: plan the holders of the planned titles, their courts and close family, from a 1.20 reference save

name: transplant-write
description: write everything R14-R16 planned, ids translated, references outside the output dropped, seams stitched

name: version-bump
description: set meta_data version/save_game_version to the target
